sql: SELECT t.*, a.account_name, a.account_tier, a.duns_number, a.account_owner, a.owner_email, c.erp_customer_id, c.customer_name FROM service_tickets t JOIN crm_accounts a ON a.account_id=t.account_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.duns_number=a.duns_number WHERE t.ticket_id='SR-39385'
gated_sql: SELECT t.*, a.account_name, a.account_tier, a.duns_number, a.account_owner, a.owner_email, c.erp_customer_id, c.customer_name FROM service_tickets AS t JOIN crm_accounts AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN customers AS c ON c.duns_number = a.duns_number WHERE t.ticket_id = 'SR-39385' LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT at, event, actor, detail FROM ticket_events WHERE ticket_id='SR-39385' ORDER BY julianday(at)
gated_sql: SELECT at, event, actor, detail FROM ticket_events WHERE ticket_id = 'SR-39385' ORDER BY JULIANDAY(at) LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT o.ticket_id, o.opened_at, o.product_sku, o.status, o.restored_at, (SELECT group_concat(credit_id||':'||amount_usd||':'||approved_on) FROM service_credits s WHERE s.ticket_id=o.ticket_id) credits FROM service_tickets o WHERE o.account_id='CRM-2048' ORDER BY julianday(o.opened_at)
gated_sql: SELECT o.ticket_id, o.opened_at, o.product_sku, o.status, o.restored_at, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(credit_id || ':' || amount_usd || ':' || approved_on) FROM service_credits AS s WHERE s.ticket_id = o.ticket_id) AS credits FROM service_tickets AS o WHERE o.account_id = 'CRM-2048' ORDER BY JULIANDAY(o.opened_at) LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT employee_id, full_name, preferred_name, title, department, email FROM employees WHERE title IN ('VP Sales','Chief Revenue Officer','Support Escalation Manager','Director of Customer Support','Support Engineering Lead','Support Billing Manager') OR department LIKE '%Support%' OR email='sarah.chen@northstar.example'
